services.desc: After six years and a wildfire that changed our property, we’re grateful to welcome guests back to Rivers Edge Cabins once again. Have you always wanted your own riverfront cabin? Now you can rent one of our cabins nightly or monthly and enjoy the peace and beauty of this special place. Travel along Highway 1 through the Fraser Canyon to the Nahatlatch River, where you’ll find Rivers Edge Cabins-a quiet retreat where you can hike, fish, raft, or simply relax on the porch and take in the sounds of the river.
